# Code of Conduct

## Our commitment

We want participation in Domoticz-Synology-SNMP to be a respectful, constructive, and welcoming experience for everyone, regardless of experience level, background, identity, or personal circumstances.

## Expected behaviour

Examples of behaviour that helps create a positive environment include:

- Being considerate, respectful, and patient.
- Giving constructive feedback and accepting it graciously.
- Focusing on what is best for the project and its users.
- Respecting different viewpoints and levels of experience.
- Sharing technical details in a clear, helpful way.

## Unacceptable behaviour

Harassment, personal attacks, discriminatory language, intimidation, deliberate disruption, and publishing private information without permission are not acceptable.

Technical disagreement is welcome; hostile or demeaning conduct is not.

## Maintainer responsibilities

Project maintainers may edit, remove, or decline comments, issues, pull requests, or other contributions that violate this Code of Conduct. They may also temporarily or permanently restrict participation when necessary.

## Reporting

To report behaviour that violates this Code of Conduct, contact the project maintainer privately through GitHub: https://github.com/janreimen

Please include relevant links or context where possible. Reports will be reviewed as promptly and fairly as practical, and handled with discretion.

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies in project spaces, including issues, pull requests, discussions, and other project-related interactions.

## Acknowledgement

This policy is inspired by common open-source community standards and is intended to support a safe, respectful, and productive project community.
